diagnosis: ProjectActivityFeedView generates an activity stream via model_stream(project) after querying WorkspaceProject solely by project_id. Because it fails to verify whether request.user belongs to the project's member list or organization, any authenticated platform user can monitor the complete real-time development activity, commit messages, and deployment notices of proprietary projects.
